_meta.what: Plain-English label and gloss per CEG dimension the UI touches. Keys are exact registry prefixes, or envelope:<member> for the CC 2.1 envelope members the receipt shows. Every key must resolve or gen_dimension_table.py refuses.
_meta.how: Add a row when a screen first renders the family. The generator emits localization keys ceg.<slug>.label / ceg.<slug>.gloss; the English lives in en.json and the 28 locales follow through localization/localize.py.

envelope:subject_key_ids.label: Who it is about
envelope:subject_key_ids.gloss: The people this record names. Each of them can take it back.

envelope:attesting_key_id.label: Who sent it
envelope:attesting_key_id.gloss: The key that signed this record. Nobody else could have.

envelope:cohort_scope.label: Who can see it
envelope:cohort_scope.gloss: The circle this record may travel in. Leaving it asks first.

envelope:dimension.label: What it is
envelope:dimension.gloss: The kind of record, in the shared vocabulary every node reads the same way.

envelope:consent:scope.label: The rule it follows
envelope:consent:scope.gloss: What may happen next with this record: kept, shared, or analysed.

consent:{kind}.label: Consent
consent:{kind}.gloss: What a person has agreed may happen with records that name them, or what a node has agreed to send a peer.

trust:{job}:{version}.label: Vouches for
trust:{job}:{version}.gloss: A claim that one key stands behind another for a stated job.

holds_bytes:sha256:{prefix}.label: Holds a copy
holds_bytes:sha256:{prefix}.gloss: A node saying it holds the bytes for a file, named by their hash.

objection:{state}.label: Someone spoke up
objection:{state}.gloss: One person's objection, and where it stands. Never rate-limited.

content_class:{class}.label: Kind of content
content_class:{class}.gloss: What sort of thing a file is, from a closed list every node shares.

credits:{domain}:{language}:{subject}.label: Commons credits
credits:{domain}:{language}:{subject}.gloss: Earned by helping. They only go up, and they cannot be sent or sold.

prohibited:{category}.label: Not allowed
prohibited:{category}.gloss: A mark that something crossed one of the lines the constitution draws. It is only ever a minus.

delivery_receipt:{stream_id}.label: Receipt
delivery_receipt:{stream_id}.gloss: A record that something was delivered. Undoing the receipt does not undo the delivery.
